transcript.text: Last year was a blur—between Chengdu and Shanghai I felt like I lived out of a suitcase.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: In Chengdu I remember chatting about home services because my place needed a deep clean, but it got handled back then so I never had to think about it again.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Then in Shanghai I ended up doing a car rental thing—honestly I usually hate driving there, but it worked out that time.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Oh, and I had this quick stop in Beijing too—spent way too long circling for parking, which was the most Beijing experience ever.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Anyway, the Chengdu clean was already booked for 2025-03-27 at 16:00, and the address on it was Room 852, Building B, West District.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: The phone they used on that Chengdu booking was 13878282690. And the Shanghai rental was a Toyota Corolla—pickup date was 2025-03-19 for 6 days, under Zhou Jun.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: For Beijing parking, my friend had reserved Zhongguancun Plaza Parking starting 2025-03-27 12:00 for 1 hour—plate was 粤D12631 and the driver phone was 13817621950. After that I still squeezed in a couple Shanghai attractions, just wandering around.
